# Vibe Rescue

> Vibe Rescue is a MIT-licensed command-line toolkit that maps an unfamiliar Git repository (files, functions, imports, calls; Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, Go, Java, PHP, C#), finds concrete problems with free static-analysis tools (dead code, copy-paste, over-complex functions, import cycles, unused dependencies, security mistakes, leaked secrets), and prepares small reversible fixes only after a human approves. Version 0.5.0rc1 (release candidate). Mapping and problem-finding need no AI. The AI report/plan/repair steps run through the command-line agent programs Claude Code and Codex, or through a built-in adapter (scripts/openai_agent.py) for any OpenAI-style model server (open models you host or any hosted model); the adapter has been tested with a scripted fake server and one full run on a toy project with one hosted model, not yet with Gemma or Qwen on a real server. Unattended repair of production code is not approved. The map is static: it shows who can call whom, not run-time behavior.

## How it works
- [Owner pact](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/OWNER_PACT.md): nothing changes without human approval, backup and revert (Vietnamese)
- [Voyage protocol](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/VOYAGE.md): map, prove, review, plan, repair, lock (Vietnamese)
- [Pipeline](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/PIPELINE.md): entry and exit criteria of each phase (Vietnamese)
- [Logic atlas](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/LOGIC_ATLAS.md): what the maps can and cannot show (Vietnamese)
- [Output protocol](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/OUTPUT_PROTOCOL.md): the plain-language report for the team (Vietnamese)

## Safety and limits
- [Security](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/SECURITY.md): a Git worktree is not a sandbox; redaction is best effort
- [Small-model evaluation](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/SMALL_MODEL_EVAL.md): sample-task test for open and cheap models, with results and limits (Vietnamese)
